name: corrective-rag
context: RAG pipelines that must self-heal: retrieved documents are evaluated for quality and relevance; weak sets trigger re-retrieval or web search before generation.
benefits: Mixes local corpus and web fallback
use_cases: Support answers verified against the knowledge base
avoid_when: Latency-sensitive use cases where reranking overhead is prohibitive
anti_patterns: Always falling back to the web
No fallback index (re-runs same failed search)
design_principles: Fallback ladder: re-retrieve, then web, then refuse
best_practices: Calibrate the evaluator on labeled pairs
Tune thresholds on golden failure set
references: Yan et al., Corrective Retrieval Augmented Generation, 2024 — https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.15884
Gao et al., Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Large Language Models: A Survey, 2024 — https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.10997
